title: Pretraining Objectives — Data Mixture Is Part of the Objective
key_insight: Deduplication, quality filters, language balance, and source weights shape the effective objective. Hold out contamination-sensitive benchmarks before training.
body:
## Data Mixture Is Part of the Objective

A technically correct loss still creates a poor model because duplicate spam dominates the corpus. The examples determine what minimizing loss means.

Deduplication, quality filters, language balance, and source weights shape the effective objective. Hold out contamination-sensitive benchmarks before training.

Curricula can change the mixture or sequence length over time. Record every version so model behavior can be traced to its data route.
common_mistakes: Pretraining guarantees every generated claim is true.
A causal model trains by reading the answer tokens ahead.
Data quality cannot affect a fixed mathematical loss.
mini_exercise: Draw “Data Mixture Is Part of the Objective” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: The objective determines what patterns a foundation model is rewarded for learning before task-specific adaptation.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Data Mixture Is Part of the Objective,” explain Pretraining Objectives without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
